prompt: Which president featured on a U.S. coin in 1972 served the longest as President of the United States of America?
answer: **Franklin D. Roosevelt**—featured on the 1972 Roosevelt dime—served the longest as U.S. president, from 1933 until his death in 1945. He remains the only president elected to more than two terms.
